remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Published in Chatham Episcopal Institute yearbook, *Mortar Board*, 1905, of which O'Keeffe was art editor. Copy consulted owned by Chatham Hall (formerly Chatham Episcopal Institute), Chatham, Virginia. Reproductions of signed illustrations; whereabouts of originals unknown. Published on page 40. description: Reproduction of signed illustration. A woman seen in profile looks downward. The woman's hair is pulled into a severe bun. Text overlaps the image. To the right of this illustration, another woman in a skirt and billowing blouse stirs a steaming liquid in a glass vial. Text below the image reads "Young ladies H2S has a very disagreeable odor." Both illustrations include O'Keeffe's signature.
dimensions: 6 1/8 x 8 or 8 x 6 1/8 inches, sheet, orientations vary
